nodes.description: Public counter of minted tokens in PolaroidNights, incremented after each mint.
Public base URI string used by _baseURI() and tokenURI().
Maximum token supply tracked by WithLimitedSupply.
Counters.Counter tracking how many tokens have been minted.
Mapping used by RandomlyAssigned to store shuffled token index assignments.
Initial token ID offset used by RandomlyAssigned.nextToken().
Owner address stored by Ownable.
PolaroidNights constructor: initializes ERC721 metadata, RandomlyAssigned supply/startFrom and mints 3 tokens to the deployer.
Public payable mint function; enforces supply, availability, tx.origin==msg.sender and per-address balance limits, then calls nextToken and _safeMint.
Returns the metadata URI for a token, appending '.json'.
onlyOwner payable function that sends the whole contract balance to msg.sender via send().
Internal override returning the stored baseURI string.
RandomlyAssigned.nextToken override: derives a pseudo-random index from msg.sender and block fields, updates tokenMatrix and returns the new token ID.
Returns the maximum token supply.
Returns the current number of minted tokens from the counter.
Returns totalSupply() - tokenCount().
Modifier restricting execution to the contract owner by comparing owner() with _msgSender().
Returns the current owner address from _owner.
Internal ERC721 safe mint that mints and then calls _checkOnERC721Received on the recipient.
Internal ERC721 mint that updates _balances and _owners and emits Transfer.
Internal Ownable function that writes the new owner into _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Internal function updating _totalSupply after checking it is not below the current token count.
Caller-controlled address used for payment, ownership, balance and randomness checks.
Miner-influenced block timestamp consumed by the pseudo-random generator in nextToken().
Origin address compared against msg.sender inside mint() as a contract-caller guard.
payable(msg.sender).send(address(this).balance) external value transfer performed inside withdraw().
keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender, block.coinbase, block.difficulty, block.gaslimit, block.timestamp)) % maxIndex pseudo-random token index generation.
currentSupply++ executed in mint() after _safeMint, creating a post-external-call state update.
_balances[to] += 1 arithmetic update performed in _mint().
require(tx.origin == msg.sender) inside mint(), an authorization check based on tx.origin.
Destination address parameter of mint(address _to).
Token identifier parameter of tokenURI(uint256 tokenId).
New supply parameter of _setSupply(uint256 _supply).
Local uint256 id in mint(), assigned from nextToken() and passed to _safeMint().
Local uint256 random index computed in nextToken().
Local uint256 maxIndex = totalSupply() - tokenCount() in nextToken().
Local uint256 value holding the token matrix result in nextToken().
Local string currentBaseURI read from _baseURI() in tokenURI().

edges.reason: msg.sender drives the owner comparison, balance limits and payment checks inside mint().
mint() authorizes callers using tx.origin == msg.sender, a discouraged tx.origin authorization pattern.
withdraw() forwards the full balance to the untrusted msg.sender address.
The external send() transfers value to the caller-controlled msg.sender, which may execute fallback code.
block.timestamp feeds the token index randomness in nextToken(), making results miner-influenced.
block.timestamp is a component of the keccak256 pseudo-random index used for token assignment.
msg.sender is packed into the randomness hash inside nextToken().
mint() calls nextToken() to obtain the new token ID.
The pseudo-random index computation is executed within nextToken().
nextToken() reads and writes tokenMatrix entries.
nextToken() calls super.nextToken() which increments the _tokenCount counter.
nextToken() assigns the derived random value to the local random variable.
nextToken() computes maxIndex from the available token count.
nextToken() stores the selected matrix value in the local value variable.
mint() calls _safeMint(), which performs an external callback to the recipient contract before mint() finalizes currentSupply.
_safeMint() invokes onERC721Received on the receiving contract, allowing it to re-enter mint() before state finalization.
_safeMint() performs the underlying mint through _mint().
_mint() increments the recipient balance counter.
withdraw() uses the low-level send() to move ether, an external interaction performed before returning.
mint() enforces the tx.origin == msg.sender restriction.
mint() increments currentSupply after minting, an unchecked-style counter update.
The currentSupply++ operation writes the currentSupply state variable.
mint() uses the _to parameter as the mint recipient.
mint() stores the nextToken() result in the local id and passes it to _safeMint().
The constructor calls mint(msg.sender) three times to bootstrap the collection.
tokenURI() calls _baseURI() to obtain the metadata prefix.
tokenURI() consumes the tokenId parameter for the existence check and string conversion.
tokenURI() stores _baseURI() output in the local currentBaseURI.
_baseURI() reads the baseURI state variable.
_setSupply() uses the _supply parameter to update the total supply.
_setSupply() writes the new value into the _totalSupply state variable.
withdraw() is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
The onlyOwner modifier calls owner() for the authorization comparison.
The modifier compares the untrusted _msgSender() (msg.sender) against the owner.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
_transferOwnership() overwrites the _owner state variable.
tokenCount() reads the counter state variable.
totalSupply() returns the _totalSupply state variable.
availableTokenCount() calls totalSupply().
availableTokenCount() calls tokenCount().
mint() calls availableTokenCount() for the availability check.
mint() calls tokenCount() for the supply check.
mint() calls totalSupply() for the maximum supply check.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter only has meaning as the recipient argument of mint(address _to) and should be folded into the mint function node.
The tokenId parameter is only referenced by tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) and should be merged into that function node.
The _supply parameter is used exclusively by _setSupply(uint256 _supply) and should be absorbed into it.
The local id exists only within mint() and is passed directly to _safeMint, so it merges into the mint function node.
The local random index is computed and consumed entirely inside nextToken().
maxIndex is derived from totalSupply() and tokenCount() inside nextToken() and has no independent semantics.
The local value holds the tokenMatrix lookup result inside nextToken() and should merge into that function node.
currentBaseURI is a temporary inside tokenURI() holding the _baseURI() result and merges into tokenURI.
